title: AI Automation Intern, Communications
description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

About the role

Group Communications supports senior leadership and works across a wide network of portfolio companies, partners and AI initiatives. We want to get much better at using AI tools and data to track what is said about us, manage our relationships, and measure the value of our work.

You will join the team as a hands-on AI intern. You will set up tools, build simple workflows and give the team the insight it needs to make decisions faster. It is a practical role with real ownership and direct exposure to senior leaders.

Help the Group Communications team use AI and data to work smarter: set up media monitoring, build a shared stakeholder CRM and track the metrics that show our impact.

Priority use cases

1. Media monitoring platform

  • Help assess, set up and configure a media monitoring platform, using AI for tagging, sentiment and summaries.

  • Define the search terms, sources and alerts for the Group, key executives and priority topics.

  • Produce regular media summaries and flag emerging issues or opportunities to the team.

  • Test AI tools that make monitoring faster and more accurate, and recommend improvements.

2. Stakeholder CRM: Ventures, Illuminate, AI House India, AI House Amsterdam

  • Design and build a simple, shared CRM for contacts, partners, media and events across the four areas.

  • Consolidate existing contact lists, clean the data, and set clear rules for how the team keeps it current.

  • Use AI to enrich records, log interactions and surface follow-ups.

  • Train team members to use it and make sure it meets data privacy (GDPR) requirements.

3. Metrics and data tracking

  • Agree a core set of communications KPIs with the team, for example reach, share of voice, sentiment, engagement and event outcomes.

  • Build a dashboard that pulls data from monitoring, social and CRM sources.

  • Produce monthly and quarterly reporting with clear insights for leadership.

  • Automate data collection and reporting where possible to save the team time.

What success looks like

  • First 3 months: media monitoring is live with regular summaries, and the CRM structure is agreed and populated.

  • By the end of the internship: the team uses the CRM day to day, a KPI dashboard is in place, and there is clear handover documentation so the tools keep running.

What you bring

  • A current student or recent graduate in communications, data, business, computer science or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot and curiosity about how to apply them.

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and comfort working with data.

  • A structured way of working, with the ability to turn messy information into clear systems.

  • Clear written English and the confidence to work with senior stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Experience with a CRM (for example HubSpot, Salesforce or Airtable) or a media monitoring tool (for example Meltwater or Cision).

  • Dashboarding skills in Power BI, Looker Studio or Tableau.

  • Basic automation or scripting, for example Zapier, Power Automate or Python.


Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

title: Account Executive (AU, NZ)
description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the role

We’re hiring an Account Executive to own Australia and New Zealand across our commercial and enterprise segments. You’ll sell to founders, engineering leaders, and technical buyers, and you’ll move between a two person startup in Auckland and a regulated enterprise in Sydney in the same week. We’re after someone who has done this before, enjoys the technical depth of the work, and wants to help define how Supabase sells in the region.

What you’ll do

  • Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to close, including multi threaded enterprise deals

  • Run technical discovery and tie it to business outcomes the buyer cares about

  • Work with Sales Engineers and Product on demos, proofs of concept, and architecture reviews

  • Help customers see where Supabase fits in their stack and what it replaces

  • Build and run your own ANZ territory plan, including pipeline, forecasting, and account strategy

  • Work with AWS and regional partners and resellers to open and progress deals

  • Handle data residency, security, and procurement conversations with enterprise and public sector buyers

  • Hand off to Customer Success so customers onboard well and expand

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in a technical sales role, ideally selling developer tools, databases, cloud infrastructure, or open source

  • A record of consistently beating quota, with numbers you can walk us through

  • Experience closing both fast moving commercial deals and longer enterprise cycles with procurement, security, and legal involved

  • Enough technical fluency to hold a credible conversation with an engineer without bringing a Sales Engineer to every call

  • Comfort selling to founders, CTOs, and platform teams

  • Strong judgment about where to spend your time across a territory spanning two countries and several time zones

  • Self-directed, at ease with ambiguity, and happy to build the playbook as you go

Nice to have

  • Experience with Postgres, or a competing backend or database platform

  • An existing network across the ANZ startup, scale-up, and developer ecosystem

  • Experience with cloud marketplace or co-sell motions, particularly AWS

  • Familiarity with ANZ compliance expectations, such as Australian Privacy Act, NZ Privacy Act, or financial services and government requirements

Why Supabase

You’ll sell a product developers already love, with real inbound demand and a fast growing open source community behind it. The territory is yours, the ownership is real, and the team is small enough that your ideas get used rather than filed.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.

  • Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking.

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

Caringhand Home Health Solutions, Inc. is committed to providing professional nursing and healthcare services that help patients achieve the highest possible level of independence in their daily activities. We strive to deliver high-quality home health care through comprehensive patient assessments, individualized care planning, and collaboration among healthcare professionals, patients, and families.

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to provide skilled nursing care to patients in their homes and communities. The RN will assess patient and family needs, develop and implement individualized care plans, administer prescribed medications and treatments, educate patients and caregivers, and coordinate care with physicians and other healthcare professionals.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong clinical judgment, excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. This role also involves discharge planning, case management when assigned, and supervising and evaluating home health aide services to support safe, coordinated, and effective patient care.

If you are passionate about helping patients maintain their independence and well-being at home, we encourage you to join our team.

Note: This is a field-based, per diem position that requires travel to patientsâ homes. Although listed as âremote,â this is not a work-from-home or telehealth role.

Responsibilities
    • Conduct initial patient and family assessments to determine home health care needs, including physical assessments and histories of current and previous illnesses.
    • Regularly reassess patientsâ nursing needs and evaluate changes in their conditions.
    • Initiate and revise individualized plans of care as patient status and needs change.
    • Use assessment findings to establish nursing diagnoses and develop appropriate care plans.
    • Develop care plans that establish patient-centered goals and incorporate therapeutic, preventive, and rehabilitative nursing interventions.
    • Involve patients and their families in care planning and decision-making.
    • Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by the physician.
    • Implement appropriate preventive and rehabilitative nursing procedures.
    • Counsel patients and families regarding nursing and related healthcare needs.
    • Provide patient and caregiver education based on assessments and the established plan of care.

    • Communicate patient needs and changes in condition to physicians, and obtain or receive physician orders as required.
    • Coordinate with community healthcare professionals and other relevant parties to support the patient's plan of care.
    • Participate in on-call duties according to organizational policy.
    • Ensure arrangements for necessary equipment, supplies, and other patient services.

    • Current CPR certification.
    • Valid driver's license and access to a reliable vehicle insured in accordance with state and organizational requirements.
    • Excellent observation and clinical assessment skills.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
    • Effective problem-solving skills and basic mathematical skills.
    • Ability to perform nursing duties according to established competency requirements.
    • Ability to work independently and coordinate patient care responsibilities.
    • Ability to perform the physical duties associated with patient care, including prolonged standing or walking, lifting supplies and equipment, and assisting with patient positioning or transfers, with applicable accommodations.

title: Care Expert - Customer Training (m/f/d)
description:
🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 Your Mission

As a Care Expert, you are the trusted care advisor for voize's most important care group customers. Together with their Customer Success Manager, you make sure voize really changes how care teams work - not just that it goes live. You speak with QM-Leitungen and Pflegedienstleitungen as a peer, because you have done their job. Your success shows in adoption and in the time teams get back.

🚀 Your Daily Business

  • Support 6-10 strategic care group accounts as their care expert, side by side with their Customer Success Manager

  • Look at QM processes, documentation routines and the EHR setup (e.g. Vivendi) before go-live, so mismatches surface early instead of during rollout

  • Talk with QM-Leitungen and Pflegedienstleitungen as a peer about process design, how documentation is structured, and change management - in their language, not ours

  • Review adoption with customer leadership after go-live and share clear, practical recommendations on voize settings and on care workflows

  • Bring what you see across accounts back to our Product team, and name clearly what is a process topic, an EHR setup topic, or a real product need

🤝 Your Skillset

  • You have worked as Pflegedienstleitung, QM-Beauftragte/r or in a similar senior care quality or operations role - at the level of the people you will advise

  • You know QM processes, care documentation standards and EHR systems (ideally Vivendi/Snap) in stationärer Altenpflege

  • You speak fluent German and can meet a careful Pflegedienstleitung, a cautious Geschäftsführung and a busy IT admin on the same day, each in their own way

  • You think in a structured way and can tell whether something is a process topic, a system setup topic, or a change management topic - and what helps in each case

  • You enjoy close collaboration: with CSMs, with Product, and on building the Care Expert playbook together

🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle new topics, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving healthcare professionals more time for real patient care

  • We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely from Germany

  • Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

  • Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible

  • You decide when you work best; that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up.

✨ Ready to talk? Apply now! 🚀

We look forward to your application and can’t wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!

title: Finance Systems Intern
description:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Finance Systems Intern, you will help run and improve the quote-to-cash systems behind Parloa’s enterprise contracts. You will learn how signed agreements (annual commits, usage-based pricing, ramps and one-time fees) become accurate subscriptions and invoices across SAP Subscription Billing, NetSuite and Salesforce. This is a full-time, 6-month internship in Berlin, starting as soon as possible, with a dedicated mentor and real project work from your first weeks.

This is your opportunity to get hands-on with a modern quote-to-cash stack at a fast-growing AI company and take your own automation project from idea to delivery.

Areas of ownership:

  • Billing Operations: Set up and amend customer subscriptions from signed contracts and run pre-billing checks on billing runs and invoices, with team review before anything goes live. Investigate rating, pricing and master-data errors so customers are billed correctly.

  • Systems Configuration and Reporting: Maintain SAP Subscription Billing master data such as products, rate plans, pricing elements, and billing profiles, configuring and testing changes before they reach production. Build NetSuite saved searches, reports, and data imports, and support month-end close and reconciliations.

  • Cross-System Data Integrity: Keep products, billable metrics, and customer data consistent across Salesforce, SAP, and NetSuite. Build reports that flag mismatches before they turn into billing issues.

  • Issue Triage and Controls: Reproduce and document billing and finance-systems issues as clear, reproducible tickets for the team or our partners. Write and execute test cases for new features, and keep change logs and audit evidence current.

  • Process Automation: Write SOPs, process maps, and user guides for finance colleagues, then spot manual steps and automate them with scripts, integrations or AI tools. One of these becomes your own internship project, which you present at the end of your internship.

Who you are:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Information Systems, Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field for the full duration of the internship, and available full-time for 6 months

  • First exposure to an ERP, billing or CRM system (such as SAP, NetSuite, Salesforce, Zuora or Stripe Billing) through coursework, a university project, a previous internship or a working-student role

  • Strong spreadsheet skills and the willingness to learn to read a JSON payload or an API error message; SQL or scripting experience (Python, Google Apps Script, n8n or Zapier) is a plus

  • A systems mindset and real interest in how a contract becomes an invoice and a journal entry: when something breaks, you keep tracing it until you find the root cause

  • Precise in how you work and handle financial data, with fluent written and spoken English and the confidence to ask questions and speak up with facts

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

 

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. Please click here to learn more. If you receive an offer of employment from Parloa, you will need to go through the E-Verify process of digital verification of your employment authorization documents as provided on the Form I-9. Participation in E-Verify does not limit your right to work and verification will only be completed after you become an employee with Parloa.

* We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, national origin, disability status, socioeconomic background and other characteristics.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Merge is the leading provider of agentic tools and customer-facing integrations for frontier LLMs, Fortune 500 organizations, and B2B SaaS companies.

Our platform offers two core products: Merge for Product, and Merge for Workforce. Merge for Product enables teams to ship AI features and integrations at massive scale. Merge for Workforce helps engineering teams govern AI access at the company level. Merge's enterprise-grade platform handles the entire integration lifecycle, from authentication and security to monitoring and maintenance. Thousands of companies trust Merge to accelerate product development, unblock sales, reduce customer churn, and save engineering resources—allowing them to focus on their core product.

Merge is seeking an experienced DevOps engineer to join our Foundations Engineering team. The right person will be a key player in driving new data and services strategies when it comes to infrastructure and AWS decisions for Merge, as well as being critical to delivering on re-architecture strategy as we scale the company.

What will you be doing?

  • With reliability and scalability in mind, work with the rest of the engineering team to produce highly performant architectures that extend to some of our largest customers, reading and writing millions of rows per second across numerous databases, workers, and services

  • Participate in roadmapping, architecture, and planning discussions

  • Produce high-quality, production-ready, maintainable infrastructure as code

  • Lead large projects from initial inception to production

  • Run production systems at scale

  • Participate in on-call rotation and infrastructure maintenance

What experience is required?

  • 4+ years of full-time DevOps experience

  • Deep experience with AWS/GCP cloud infrastructure, Terraform, and Kubernetes

  • Ability to own the planning and deployment of highly scalable systems

  • Familiarity with some or all of the following technologies: AWS Aurora, Redshift, Kinesis, EC2, EKS, ECS, Redis, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics

Compensation

  • The cash compensation range for this role is $155,000-$185,000.

  • Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications. In addition to cash compensation, all employees receive an equity compensation package.

Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO + 10 company holidays

  • Pre-Tax commuter benefits

  • 100% covered health, vision, and dental insurance

  • 401K Plan

  • $200 one-time home office stipend, and free dinner when working past 6pm

  • Annual company off-sites and quarterly team events. Past locations have included: Nashville, Sonoma, Hudson Valley, San Diego

title: Vertriebsmitarbeiter im Außendienst (x/f/m) - Göttingen
description:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung 

Der deutsche Gesundheitsmarkt befindet sich an einem entscheidenden Wendepunkt – und Du digitalisierst ihn, Praxis für Praxis. Als Vertriebsmitarbeiter im Außendienst (x/f/m) in Göttingen führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business und bringst mit unserer KI-gestützten All-in-One Lösung echten Mehrwert direkt in den Praxisalltag. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben. 

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Eigenverantwortlicher Vertrieb: Du begleitest den gesamten Sales-Prozess – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss

  • Umsatz & Wachstum: Du bist verantwortlich für Deine Pipeline, den Umsatz (MRR), Beziehungen und das Wachstum in Deiner Region 

  • Kundenzentrierte Beratung: Du analysierst die Bedürfnisse von Ärzt:innen, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und begeisterst sie mit unserer digitalen Lösung

  • Datengetriebene Erfolgsmessung: Du trackst Deine Performance regelmäßig mit Salesforce und nutzt Daten für eine gezielte Vertriebsstrategie

 

Dein Profil

  • Sales ist Deine Welt: Du hast mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb (idealerweise im Außendienst und B2B-Bereich)

  • Proaktivität und Akquise-Talent: Du glänzt mit exzellenten Akquise- und Pitching-Skills

  • Energie & Überzeugungskraft: Du hast ein hohes Energielevel, verkaufst mit Leidenschaft und überzeugst mit Deinem sicheren und professionellen Auftreten

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du bist ergebnisorientiert, hast ein hohes Organisationsgeschick und behältst auch bei Herausforderungen den Fokus

  • Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du kannst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) ausdrücken
    Für unsere internen Trainings, All-Hands und den Austausch mit internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen ist es hilfreich, wenn du Englisch gut verstehen kannst. Falls du dich sprachlich noch weiterentwickeln möchtest, unterstützen wir dich gerne mit entsprechenden Lernangeboten. Perfektes Englisch ist keine Voraussetzung. Deine Kundentermine finden auf Deutsch statt.

  • Flexibilität & Mobilität: Dein Vertriebsalltag findet dort statt, wo es zählt: direkt bei Ärzt:innen vor Ort. Ein Führerschein Klasse B ist vorausgesetzt

 

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

 

Was wir Dir bieten 

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Einen Firmenwagen – auch privat nutzbar, versteuert nach der 1%-Regelung

  • Eine private Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)

  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 %

  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das 1 Monat extra Elternzeit u.v.m. enthält

  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über unseren externen Partner moka.care

  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

 

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team, das gewinnen will. Du auch? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil der Doctolib-Erfolgsgeschichte! Weitere Informationen zum Arbeitsalltag im Sales bei Doctolib findest Du hier. 

 

Der Interview-Prozess  

  1. Interview mit unserem Talent Team (remote - 30')

title: Incident Response Engineer 2
description:
Role Summary

Sophos is seeking an intermediate-level Incident Response Analyst to support its Managed Detection and Response (MDR) customers within the Critical Incident Response Team (CIRT).

As an Incident Response Analyst 2, you will perform advanced investigative, forensic, and containment activities during active cyber incidents. You will operate with moderate autonomy, serve primarily in an Incident Responder role, and begin supporting Incident Advisors with validated technical findings and customer-facing context. This role serves as the technical backbone of most engagements and includes mentoring junior analysts to ensure consistent execution and documentation quality.


What You Will Do

  • Perform advanced investigative and forensic analysis across endpoints, network logs, and cloud telemetry

  • Execute containment and response actions to neutralize active threats as directed by Incident Advisors or Senior Analysts

  • Validate indicators of compromise (IOCs) and correlate alerts, artifacts, and telemetry to determine scope and root cause

  • Maintain clear and accurate engagement documentation, including trailheads, timelines, and playbooks

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior IR and SOC analysts to ensure adherence to CIRT investigative and documentation standards

  • Prepare technical findings and summaries for inclusion in customer updates and post-incident reports

  • Identify and communicate detection or response gaps observed during investigations

  • Participate in shift handovers, debriefs, and post-incident reviews to ensure engagement continuity

  • Maintain accurate time and activity tracking to support operational visibility and service improvement

What You Will Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in incident response, MDR, SOC, or security operations roles

  • Solid technical understanding of endpoint forensics, log analysis, and common attack techniques

  • Experience investigating malware, credential theft, ransomware, or similar threats

  • Ability to correlate alerts and telemetry to determine incident scope and root cause

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting findings and contributing to customer updates

  • Experience mentoring or guiding junior analysts

  • Ability to work effectively in high-pressure, time-sensitive incident environments

  • Willingness to work some weekends and holidays as part of a rotation

  • Hands-on experience with EDR, SIEM, and forensic collection tools

  • Familiarity with OSQuery, SQL, or KQL

  • Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and incident response frameworks

  • Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCED, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent

  • Experience contributing to playbooks, detection tuning, or service improvement initiatives

What does remote mean at Sophos?
Sophos supports flexible ways of working, with many roles offered remotely and others working in a hybrid model. For remote roles, you may work remotely within the location specified in the job posting. Candidates must reside in and be authorized to work in that location. Our teams collaborate across locations and time zones, using technology to stay connected and deliver results.

 

Our Commitment To You

Sophos welcomes applicants with diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds. We believe great ideas come from different ways of thinking, and we are committed to building a workplace where people can contribute, grow, and succeed.

We evaluate all candidates based on job-related skills, qualifications, and experience, and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities consistent with applicable laws and regulations.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please contact ----- Any information shared will be used only for the purpose of evaluating and providing the requested accommodation.

title: Associate, Revenue and Billing Operations
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

This role is part of the Revenue and Billing Operations Team, reporting to the Senior Manager Revenue and Billing Operations.

The purpose of this team is to accurately account for revenue, cost of sales and the associated balance sheet amounts, to ensure there are robust controls over processes and the balance sheet, and to provide analysis on Checkout’s net revenue results.

What you'll be doing:

  • Preparing balance sheet reconciliations for different balance sheet accounts , posting manual correction journals and working with different teams to resolve balance sheet issues.

  • Effectively business partner Finance leadership , providing commentary and analysis on Net revenue performance and balance sheet position.

  • Support the group audit for the revenue and billing operations team.

  • Hold responsibility for setting up new revenue and balance sheet recording processes, including writing procedure manuals and providing guidance to more junior members of staff.

  • Continuous improvement of reporting/ processes to assist with stakeholder requirements.

  • Set-up documentation and processes that are robust and well controlled for period end close and audit purposes.

  • Continually look at ways of improving data integrity and quality, automation, strengthening of controls, operational and reporting efficiency.

  • Perform accounting and reconciliation processes and controls across our key trading account balances.

  • Analyse and reconcile data from various systems and sources to identify control gaps and reconciliation breaks.

  • Participate in ad hoc projects as required.

Qualifications

  • Professional finance qualification such as ACCA/ CIMA or equivalent

  • Preferably with at least six years of progressive finance experience including month end reporting activities, and at least three years’ experience of balance sheet reconciliations

  • Proven ability to find end-to-end solutions to issues and work cross-functionally and with remote teams - including Finance, Product, Engineering, Data.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with ability to communicate with all levels.

  • Experience of revenue month end and ASC606/ IFRS 15.

  • Strong data analysis , excel data modelling and exposure to A.I automation tools.

  • Experienced in working in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment

  • Experienced with ERP systems (Workday Financials preferred but not required)

  • Experience of working in a high-volume, complex and dynamic environment in a complex, regulatory environment, ideally within Payments/FinTech or Financial Services

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

We want you as a talented Software Intern, Mission Control Center to help us in our mission by building and setting up the systems that power our mission operations. You will support the setup of our Mission Control Center and own the development, integration, and configuration of mission support tools used by flight controllers and engineering teams.   • Supporting the setup and commissioning of our Mission Control Center, from infrastructure and workstation configuration to operational readiness

  • Contributing across the software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment

  • Collaborating with engineering and operations teams to understand and meet operational needs

  • Writing maintainable, well-documented code and contributing to automated testing

What we would love to see from you

Required Qualifications

Education

Experience

  • Some exposure to frontend development with TypeScript/JavaScript and modern frameworks (React, Vue.js, or similar)

  • Experience with version control systems such as Git

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to work independently, ask questions, and take ownership of a scoped topic

  • Motivation to thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment

Bonus Qualifications

  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker)

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:

title: Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tools Development Intern
description:
About Pangea Propulsion:

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tool Development intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role

We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors.

During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations.

Your work will focus on three main areas:

  • Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules.
  • Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements.
  • Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour.


The developed tools will support the team in rapidly comparing injector configurations, identifying potential performance and thermal risks, and improving the overall preliminary design process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature.
  • Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation.
  • Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python.
  • Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions.
  • Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data.
  • Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data.
  • Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process.


What you need to be successful

  • Final-year student or recent graduate in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong programming skills, particularly in MATLAB and Python.
  • Good understanding of:
    • Fluid mechanics
    • Thermodynamics and heat transfer
    • Numerical methods and computational modelling
  • Experience with data processing, numerical analysis or scientific computing.
  • Ability to translate physical and engineering requirements into computational models and algorithms.
  • Ability to analyse numerical results and identify relevant physical trends.
  • Critical thinking when assessing modelling assumptions and engineering correlations.
  • Interest in rocket propulsion, combustion devices and liquid-propellant injection systems.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Autonomous, structured and methodical approach.
  • Curiosity and willingness to explore unfamiliar technical topics.
  • Ability to collaborate within a multicultural and multidisciplinary engineering team.
  • Good technical communication and documentation skills.
  • Attention to detail and critical thinking.


Nice to have

Any of the following would be a plus, but is not required:

  • Experience with liquid rocket engine injectors, combustion chambers or other combustion systems.
  • Knowledge of coaxial, impinging-jet, swirl or pintle injectors.
  • Knowledge of multiphase flows, sprays, atomisation or propellant mixing.
  • Knowledge of combustion physics, reacting flows or turbulent heat transfer.
  • Experience with thermal modelling or heat-transfer correlations.
  • Experience with CFD tools, post-processing or interpretation of reacting-flow/heat-transfer simulations.
  • Experience analysing parameters such as local mixture ratio, spray angle, wall heat flux or wall temperature.
  • Experience developing engineering correlations from numerical or experimental data.
  • Experience with geometrical algorithms, optimisation or automated engineering design tools.
  • Experience developing graphical interfaces or engineering visualisation tools.
  • Familiarity with Git or other version-control tools.


Expected internship outcomes

By the end of the internship, you will have contributed to:

  • A functional MATLAB/Python tool for automated injector layout and manifold definition.
  • An injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • A preliminary physics-based methodology for assessing injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Validation of the developed methodologies against available literature, CFD, experimental or reference data.
  • Technical documentation covering the tools, methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future integration.


Supervision and collaboration

You will be supervised by an engineer from the Combustion Devices team and collaborate closely with the future users of the tools. Technical priorities, verification cases and acceptance criteria will be reviewed regularly to ensure that the tools address practical engineering needs.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions.

Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values.

Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

title: Product & Operations Management Apprentice
description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Back Market is the world’s leading refurbished electronics marketplace, with a team of 650 people powering operations across 18 countries and counting.

Our mission is simple: empowering people to consume tech more sustainably by offering a high-quality, accessible and more eco-friendly alternative to buying new electronics. Be part of an exciting and growing international adventure that is changing the way the world consumes tech.

We are looking for a curious, organized and proactive Product & Business Operations Apprentice to join our Partnerships team.

The Partnerships team works with telecom, retail and other strategic partners to make refurbished technology more accessible to customers. We manage a growing portfolio of partnerships, launch new commercial opportunities and continuously improve the customer journeys and operating processes that support them.

This apprenticeship is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Product, Business Operations, Partnerships, Analytics and Commercial Operations. You will help the team scale its operating model by taking ownership of structured recurring activities, supporting launches and experiments, and identifying opportunities to improve our processes.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Monitor partnership health by updating dashboards, reviewing customer journeys, tracking incidents and preparing portfolio summaries.

  • Contribute to new partnership features and drive continuous improvement by managing product partnership initiatives, documenting requirements, coordinating delivery and contributing to experiments.

  • Coordinate launch and QA activities, including test plans and launch-readiness updates.

  • Support business operations through reporting, basic analysis, meeting follow-ups, documentation and invoicing reconciliation.

  • Be an active part in onboarding new partners to Back Market.

  • Contribute to new partnership projects by researching potential partners, preparing benchmarks and helping improve or automate recurring processes.

TOOLS YOU’LL USE: ⚒️

Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets and Google Slides, Slack, Jira, Confluence, Tableau or other business intelligence tools, and internal Back Market tools.

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are enrolled in a French higher-education programme that includes an apprenticeship contract.

  • You are looking for a multi-year apprenticeship, ideally in product management, business operations, partnerships, analytics, business, engineering or a related field.

  • You are fluent in both written and spoken French and English, as we are an international team. This is mandatory.

  • You are organized, rigorous and comfortable managing several topics at the same time.

  • You enjoy working with data, spreadsheets and recurring reports, and can identify trends or discrepancies.

  • You take ownership, ask good questions and follow through on commitments.

  • You are a clear and structured communicator who enjoys coordinating with different stakeholders.

  • You are curious and comfortable switching between detailed execution and a broader understanding of business objectives.

  • You are interested in product, partnerships, e-commerce, telecom, marketplaces or business operations.

  • You enjoy improving processes rather than simply repeating them.

  • You are comfortable learning new tools and working in an evolving environment.

  • You have a strong team spirit and enjoy collaborating with Product, Engineering, Finance, Analytics, Operations and customer-facing teams.

Bonus points if:

  • You have previous experience in product management, business operations, project management, partnerships or analytics.

  • You have worked with dashboards, QA processes, experiments or reporting workflows.

  • You have used automation or no-code tools.

  • You have experience in e-commerce, telecom, retail or marketplace environments.

ABOUT THE APPRENTICESHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: Ideally for 12 months (24months to be discussed).

  • Location: Bordeaux, France

  • Contract: You must already be enrolled in a work-study program in a French school (contrat d'alternance / d'apprentissage)

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • HR Interview with Campus Recruitment Manager

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager focused on your motivation, organization and analytical approach.

  • Team/Cultural fit interview with with stakeholders from tech and data.

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

title: Abacus Consultant Finance, 80-100 %
description:
Möglichkeit, von unseren Büros in Genf oder Bern aus zu arbeiten.

Du begeisterst dich für Finanzen und Rechnungswesen, möchtest aber über die Zahlen hinausgehen und aktiv zur Digitalisierung von Unternehmen beitragen?

Bei Fidigit stehen unsere Kunden im Mittelpunkt, denn wir bieten dank der Einführung von Abacus ERP und unseren engagierten Mitarbeitenden einen aussergewöhnlichen Service. Als Teil der Fidinam-Gruppe, eines führenden Beratungsunternehmens in den Bereichen Steuern, Unternehmen, Immobilien und digitale Beratung in der Schweiz, sind wir mit mehr als 15 Standorten weltweit und über 300 Beratern hervorragend aufgestellt.

Mit Standorten in Bern, Genf, Lugano, Luzern und Zürich sind wir der einzige Abacus-Vertriebspartner, der in allen drei Sprachregionen der Schweiz vertreten ist. Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, unsere Kunden in den Bereichen Digitalisierung und Prozessoptimierung zu beraten.

Was du bei uns tun wirst:

  • Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei ihren Abacus-Finanzprojekten, von der Konzeption über die Einführung bis hin zur Schulung.

  • Du bist als Berater und Teilprojektleiter tätig und übernimmst die Verantwortung für deinen Fachbereich.

  • Du analysierst Finanzprozesse und entwickelst passende Lösungen in Abacus.

  • Du arbeitest an Themen wie Finanzflüssen, Kostenrechnung, Anlagebuchhaltung, Budgetierung, Kennzahlen und Reporting.

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Parametrierung der Abacus-Anwendungen in deinem Fachgebiet.

  • Du berätst und begleitest unsere Kunden vor Ort oder remote.

  • Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und trägst zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Lösungen bei.

Dein Profil:

  • Du verfügst über eine Ausbildung im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen und hast eine hohe Affinität zu IT und Digitalisierung.

  • Du beherrschst die Grundsätze des Rechnungswesens und möchtest diese mit ERP-Systemen und digitalen Prozessen verbinden.

  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert.

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit der Einführung oder Nutzung eines ERP-Systems in einem KMU-Umfeld. Erfahrung mit Abacus ist ein grosser Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Du schätzt den Kundenkontakt und verstehst es, ihre Bedürfnisse in konkrete Lösungen umzusetzen.

  • Du beherrschst Französisch und Deutsch und bewegst dich sicher in einem professionellen englischen Umfeld.

Was wir bieten:

  • Die Möglichkeit, dich bei Fidigit durch Experten im Bereich Finanzen und Abacus-Software weiterzubilden. Zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten in diesem Tätigkeitsbereich in der Schweiz.

  • Teilnahme an Schulungen beim Hersteller Abacus in Biel, um dich schnell fundierte Kenntnisse der Abacus-Software anzueignen.

  • Abacus Platinum Partner innerhalb einer Unternehmensgruppe mit über 60 Jahren Geschichte.

  • Ein motivierendes, dynamisches und vor allem kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld. Ein Team von 8 Mitarbeitenden in Genf, 50 in der gesamten Schweiz. Zusammen mit den Teams von Fidinam sind wir rund 30 Personen an unserem Standort in Genf.

  • Ein Unternehmen mit Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz (Lugano, Zürich, Luzern, Bern, Genf).

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten.

  • Attraktive und marktgerechte Anstellungsbedingungen für alle Kompetenzstufen sowie interessante Zusatzleistungen.

title: Care Navigator (Community-Based & Field Navigation) - New York
description:
The Care Navigator supports Medicaid members and other eligible populations participating in New York Social Care Network (SCN), 1115 Waiver, In Lieu of Services (ILOS), Value-Added Benefit (VAB), and related programs. The role helps individuals identify and address health-related social needs by connecting them with appropriate services and resources.

This position delivers person-centered, culturally responsive, and trauma-informed navigation through community-based, field, telephonic, and technology-enabled settings. The Care Navigator reports to the Care Navigation Program Manager and works in a New York-based hybrid role requiring regular local travel, with occasional travel within New York State.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable engaging individuals at a busy community event, building relationships with partner organizations, and providing ongoing navigation support by phone. They are passionate about improving health equity, connecting people to critical services, and serving as a visible, trusted presence within the communities they support.

Hourly Range: $25-26/hour

NOTE: This is two openings for any posted location in New York. Please only apply for ONE position.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to

  • Conduct standardized health-related social needs screenings in accordance with state and program requirements in community, partner organization, virtual, and telephonic settings
  • Complete eligibility assessments and supporting documentation for social care services and enhanced navigation programs
  • Provide in-person screening and navigation support at community events, health fairs, enrollment events, and outreach activities
  • Build and maintain relationships with community-based organizations, healthcare providers, and local partners to increase awareness of available social care services
  • Serve as an embedded Care Navigator within designated partner organizations, as assigned, providing on-site screening, referral coordination, and navigation services
  • Initiate, monitor, and close referrals within designated referral management platforms
  • Accurately document service activities, encounters, outcomes, and time spent in accordance with program billing and reporting requirement
  • Perform closed-loop referral follow-up activities to confirm successful service connections and identify unresolved barriers
  • Conduct outreach attempts and engagement activities in accordance with program timelines and documentation standards
  • Educate individuals, caregivers, and community stakeholders regarding available benefits, community resources, and social care services
  • Coordinate with healthcare providers, managed care organizations, community-based organizations, and other stakeholders to support continuity of care
  • Represent the organization professionally in community settings and act as an ambassador for care navigation programs and services
  • Escalate complex cases, urgent social needs, safety concerns, or barriers to supervisory or clinical staff as appropriate
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA, confidentiality requirements, and all applicable federal, state, and program regulations
  • Meet productivity, quality, timeliness, documentation, and engagement standards established by the organization and program requirements
  • Participate in ongoing training, workflow development, community engagement initiatives, and quality improvement activities
  • Support reassessment, renewal, and recertification activities as required by program guidelines

Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience in healthcare, social services, behavioral health, community outreach, case management, care coordination, human services, or a related field
  • Experience engaging individuals from diverse communities and backgrounds with empathy, professionalism, and cultural humility
  • Ability to build rapport quickly in both community-based and telephonic settings
  • Experience conducting direct client interactions in-person, telephonically, or through community outreach activities
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to present information effectively to individuals, families, community partners, and stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, locations, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Ability to maintain accurate and detailed documentation in compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and technology platforms used for documentation and referral management
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and adapt to changing community and program needs
  • Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel regularly throughout assigned service areas
  • Ability to routinely use laptops, smartphones, and other mobile technology while working remotely and in the field

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Training or certification in Trauma-Informed Care, Motivational Interviewing, Crisis Intervention, and/or De-escalation Techniques
  • Experience working within New York Medicaid, Social Care Network (SCN), Managed Care, 1115 Waiver, or Health Equity initiatives
  • Experience providing care navigation, care management, community health worker services, outreach, health coaching, benefits navigation, or case management
  • Experience conducting community outreach, tabling events, health fairs, enrollment events, or grassroots engagement activities
  • Experience working with individuals experiencing food insecurity, housing instability, behavioral health conditions, substance use disorders, transportation barriers, justice involvement, or other social determinants of health
  • Bilingual proficiency preferred, particularly Spanish, Mandarin, Cantonese, Russian, Bengali, Haitian Creole, Arabic, or other languages commonly spoken in New York communities
  • Established knowledge of community resources and service networks within New York State

Physical Requirements

  • Repetitive motions that include the wrists, hands and/or fingers
  • Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting, remaining in a stationary position for prolonged periods
  • Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

Compensation

Additional Information

Company Overview

Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.

EEO

Mom’s Meals complies with all applicable federal and state non-discrimination laws. Qualified applicants shall receive consideration for employment without regards to race, religion, national origin, ancestry, color, gender, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Revenue Operations Leader, Strategy & Planning
description:
What is Contentstack?

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

Learn more at www.contentstack.com.

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!

What Are We Looking For?

Contentstack is a growth-stage enterprise SaaS company with an ambitious goal of reaching $250M ARR. Getting there means rethinking how we operate and scale our go-to-market (GTM) organization - not simply increasing costs as revenue grows.

To support this vision, we recently established our GTM Strategy & Systems (GSS) team under the Office of the CEO. This team brings strategy, systems, and execution together under one leader, connecting Revenue Operations, Analytics, GTM Applications, and a newly formed GTM Engineering capability.

We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Leader, Strategy & Planning to build the planning and performance-management foundation that powers this organization. You’ll work closely with the CRO, Finance, and GTM leaders to turn business objectives into actionable plans, establish a clear view of performance, and help the business identify and address opportunities and risks early.

This is a hands-on builder role for someone who enjoys creating structure, challenging assumptions, and turning complex data into decisions that drive growth. If you're excited to help shape how a scaling enterprise SaaS company operates, we'd love to hear from you! Here’s what you’ll be doing:

  • Lead GTM planning: Own annual planning across capacity, territories, quotas, and incentive-plan design. Build scenario models that clearly communicate tradeoffs, dependencies, and assumptions to GTM and Finance leadership.
  • Drive performance management: Establish a rigorous forecasting approach and evaluate performance against the plan across pipeline, productivity, bookings, retention, and expansion. Identify gaps and partner with GTM leaders to determine what needs to change.
  • Turn insights into action: Translate performance trends into clear recommendations, helping leadership understand risks, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions.
  • Establish measurement and governance: Define and maintain cross-functional KPIs that ensure Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success are working from consistent metrics and business definitions.
  • Improve cross-functional alignment: Identify gaps in reporting, measurement, and assumptions, and work with stakeholders to resolve issues and document agreed-upon standards.
  • Leverage AI and automation: Build agent-enabled workflows that streamline recurring analysis, surface meaningful changes, and make business insights easier to access.

What Really Gets Us Excited About You?

  • 8–15+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy, GTM Finance, or a similarly analytical role within a B2B SaaS organization.
  • Direct ownership of annual GTM planning across capacity, territories, quotas, and compensation design, with the ability to confidently defend planning assumptions with CRO and CFO-level stakeholders.
  • Strong command of forecasting, funnel economics, and SaaS growth metrics, with the hands-on ability to analyze complex pipeline, bookings, and customer data.
  • Experience with demand-generation metrics and the Marketing-to-Sales handoff, including funnel-stage definitions, conversion rates, and lead routing.
  • Hands-on experience building or significantly shaping segmentation, scoring, or attribution models, with the ability to assess the reliability of inputs and effectiveness of outputs.
  • Experience building and deploying AI or agentic workflows that expand analytical capacity, streamline recurring analysis, or improve business decision-making.
  • You’re a high-agency builder who enjoys creating new capabilities, raising standards, and rethinking processes as the business evolves.
  • You build trust across functions and are comfortable challenging assumptions with senior leaders when the data tells a different story.
  • You know when a directional answer is enough to move forward, when precision matters, and how to communicate uncertainty.
  • You stay close to the details while keeping broader business objectives in view, and know when to gather input versus when to take ownership and move forward.
  • You’ve built trusted partnerships with CROs and GTM leaders and know how to influence decisions while plans are still taking shape.
  • You value a collaborative, innovative, and fun culture!

Salary for this role ranges between $155,000-195,000 based on skill set and experience

What Do We Offer?

Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it.

Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.

Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining…

To review our Privacy Policy, please click here.
