title: Event Planner
description:
With a reputation built on excellence, innovation, and exceptional service, we empower our clients through high-touch, high-impact experiences powered by proprietary technology and world-class talent. As our U.S. Events footprint continues to grow, we are seeking a dynamic, service-obsessed, and commercially minded professional who leads by example and delivers flawless experiences that consistently exceed expectations.

In this pivotal role, you will spearhead end-to-end event planning for key clients while collaborating closely with operational leaders, Team Leads, and our wider events organization. You will leverage deep market expertise to advance client objectives, cultivate lasting cross-functional partnerships across Reed & Mackay, and maximize commercial revenue generation—all while delivering outstanding return on investment for our partners.

What You’ll Do:

  • Oversee the comprehensive coordination and execution of entire event programs, focusing on operational aspects

  • Manage specified client-based events including sourcing, contract negotiation and review, offsite activity coordination, supplier payments, invoicing, and reconciliation

  • Lead events from conception through to delivery and financial reconciliation

  • Collaborate closely with client contacts to comprehend and fulfill program objectives and outcomes

  • Provide clear guidance to the project team regarding client needs, expectations, business rules, and objectives

  • Identify opportunities to increase the value of existing and new business

  • Develop and manage client event budgets, ensuring agreed profitability through careful negotiation and commercial awareness

  • Maximize all income opportunities by leveraging enhanced commission rates and preferred partner relationships to negotiate cost savings

  • Agree and advise on setups for function rooms, including layout, seating, AV, and food & beverage needs

  • Provide out-of-hours support as necessary

  • Identify critical success factors for projects based on clients' success measures

  • Maintain meticulous project documentation to ensure compliance with contract policies, documentation standards, and Service Level Agreements

  • Generate and maintain virtual payments to suppliers as required

  • Responsible for completing Event Specific Agreements on a per-project basis

  • Prepare and review rooming lists in a timely manner to meet agreed deadlines

  • Ensure timely completion of payment, billing processes, and final financial reconciliation

  • Provide structured event feedback to all stakeholders through debrief notes for inclusion in account reviews

  • Attend internal and external meetings as required, document minutes, and follow up on outstanding action items

  • Support on-site events when necessary and coordinate client venue visits upon request

  • Comply with Reed & Mackay technology usage guidelines and systems as required

  • Work closely with the Events Leadership Team to deliver a seamless, professional service to clients

What We’re Looking For:

  • Proven experience planning a variety of events, including meetings, group accommodation, and venue sourcing

  • 2+ years of current, relevant meeting and event planning experience, ideally both nationally and internationally

  • Positive interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with colleagues, clients, and suppliers

  • Self-motivated, fostering a sense of enthusiasm and collaboration across the team

  • Strong client-facing, consultative, and presentation skills

  • Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving abilities

  • Open-minded, adaptable, and receptive to change in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong attention to detail, high customer service standards, and proven negotiation skills

  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to coordinate multiple resources and concurrent priorities

  • Ability to remain calm, focused, and effective under pressure in high-stress situations

  • Solid business acumen and commercial awareness

  • Effective influencing and stakeholder management skills

  • Professional verbal and written communication skills

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, modern project management tools, and venue sourcing platforms (especially Cvent)

  • Strong multitasking capabilities with an urgency-driven mindset to resolve time-sensitive issues efficiently

  • Empathetic approach paired with consistent, polished professionalism

  • Proven ability to adapt and thrive within a hyper-growth environment

  • Resourceful, independent thinker capable of troubleshooting issues and resolving complex customer inquiries

  • Track record of developing and maintaining strategic client, Account Manager, and Account Executive partnerships

The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity.

For roles with on-target-earnings (OTE), the pay range includes both base salary and target incentive compensation. Target incentive compensation for some roles may include a ramping draw period. Compensation is higher for those who exceed targets. Candidates may receive more information from the recruiter.

Pay Range

$60,000—$70,000 USD

Navan uses AI-assisted Automated Employment Decision Tool (Metaview) to assist with evaluating resumes against job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by human recruiters and hiring managers.

Human oversight: Metaview does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our recruiters and hiring managers review all outputs and make the final hiring decision regarding every application.

  • Your rights: If you prefer to have your application reviewed without AI assistance, you may request a human evaluation by entering your email here. Your decision to do so will not affect how your candidacy is evaluated.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about our processing of personal data, and your rights.

title: Ad Operations Specialist, Audio
description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As the Ad Operations Specialist, Audio at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

BetterHelp is one of the largest Podcast advertisers in the world, and we’ve been hard at work at scaling Radio and Streaming, as well. We’re looking for someone to help us manage and continue to evolve our ad operations for podcast, radio and digital radio advertising strategies in our US and Non-US markets. You are organized and can manage a large amount of moving pieces and deadlines.

You have experience with advertising operations, preferably in audio. You are knowledgeable on the processes of advertising involving media flighting, creative, campaign launch, and billing/reconciling. You are organized and can help manage information for hundreds of shows from an operational standpoint. You are innovative and utilize AI to improve efficiency where it makes sense, and are open-minded to creating new solutions. You love a challenge and are a great team-player.

What will you do?

  • Work alongside the Audio Strategy team by managing all operations as it relates to our podcast, radio and digital radio advertising in our US and Non-US markets. Examples include:
    • IO & Budget Management: Process insertion orders by entering the data and information of the buys into our systems, generate PO order #s with the accounting department, and assist with Billing/Reconciling at EOM to ensure all partners are paid correctly and on time.
    • Develop & Maintain QA Management: Help ensure that our ads run correctly by utilizing our QA and pixel tools like Podscribe.
    • Compliance: Manage compliance efforts for our channels ranging from brand safety checks on new partners to ensuring all creative is compliance approved, and all shows are adhering to our policies.
    • Help create new workflows and systems in order to keep our department evolving with AI and new tools for management and tracking of documents, information and processes.
  • Enjoy great teamwork, have lots of fun, and take pride in building a world-class business that makes a difference in people's lives
  • Bring the big ideas

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
  • You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
  • You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
  • You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. While we embrace the flexibility of remote work, we also value opportunities to bring teams together in person for collaboration and connection. BetterHelp covers approved expenses for company-requested travel, and reasonable accommodations are available for employees who are unable to travel.

Requirements

  • 3+ years managing ad ops for audio (podcast, radio and/or digital radio) campaigns or offline channels on either the brand, agency or publisher side.
  • Innovative mindset with a knack for improving systems and workflows for efficiency.
  • Incredibly organized and efficient with a large number of tasks and deadlines.
  • Excellent communication (oral and written), attention to detail, time management and organizational skills
  • Positive outlook and ability to work as a team

Bonus (Great to have, but not required):

  • Knowledge of audio industry tools like Podscribe and Magellan
  • Experience with Looker and Salesforce
  • Experience at a DR/DTC growth brand who buys audio

Benefits

  • Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
  • Competitive compensation
  • Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
  • The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love
  • Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive
  • An awesome community of co-workers

The base salary range for this position is $65,000 - $95,000. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2025. Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.

At BetterHelp we thrive on difference and individuality, and as part of the Teladoc Health family, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, medical condition, marital status, parental status, disability, or Veteran status.

Notice to Candidates:
BetterHelp has been made aware of fraudulent job postings and unaffiliated third parties posing as our recruiting team – please know that we have no affiliation or connection to these situations. We only post open roles on our career page (betterhelp.com/careers) or reputable job boards like our official LinkedIn or Indeed pages, and all official BetterHelp recruitment emails will come from the domain @betterhelp.com. Our commitment is to ensure a safe and transparent hiring experience for all candidates. We will never ask you for money, gift cards, or any form of payment during our hiring process, and we will never send money or checks to candidates. If you experience this, it is a scam.

title: Business Development Executive (South Australia and Tasmania, Dairy)
description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

As a Business Development Executive at Halter, you’ll drive growth across one of our most exciting combined territories: South Australia and Tasmania. You’ll own the full sales cycle, from finding new opportunities through to closing deals, and you’ll build lasting relationships with farmers as Halter’s on-the-ground representative.

This is a growth-focused role for someone who loves opening doors. You’ll spend most of your time in South Australia, where the largest opportunity sits, and around one week a month in Tasmania building on our established presence there. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support and other regional sales teams, sharing field insights to make sure Halter’s technology keeps meeting the needs of farmers.

Your work will directly support Halter’s mission to help 50% of the world’s habitable landmass become more productive and sustainable.

Location: Based in South Australia, ideally in Mount Gambier or Adelaide. Frequent travel within South Australia and regular travel to Tasmania (around one week per month) is required.

Who we’re looking for

  • Business development expertise: A strong track record in value-based sales, creating opportunities and closing deals. You’re energised by prospecting and building a pipeline from scratch, and you know how to turn new customers into long-term partners.

  • Agricultural industry experience: You understand dairy and beef operations and the challenges farmers face. If you don’t, you’re deeply passionate about the industry and willing to dive into the operations of a farm to learn fast.

  • Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. You make those around you better, thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

  • Territory management: You can manage a large, multi-state territory, using critical thinking to plan your time between South Australia and Tasmania and prioritise where you’ll have the most impact.

  • Problem solving and collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to tackle challenges and find solutions.

  • Willingness to travel: Comfortable with frequent regional travel, including regular trips to Tasmania.

What your day could look like

  • Prospecting and expansion: Sourcing new leads through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events and other channels, as well as responding to inbound enquiries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation to close.

  • Hitting sales targets: Meeting ambitious growth targets by qualifying opportunities, demonstrating the product and negotiating contracts with customers.

  • Territory ownership: Taking real ownership of your territory, working with regional agricultural groups and building deep relationships across the dairy and beef industries in both states.

  • Customer onboarding and relationships: Making sure new customers have a smooth handoff from sale to onboarding and deployment, and staying close to them afterwards so they get the most value from Halter.

  • Field learnings and feedback: Being the main point of contact for customer feedback in your territory, sharing insights with Support, Product and Research and Development teams to drive product improvements.

  • Collaborating with Support: Partnering with the Support team to resolve customer issues quickly and escalating when needed, so every customer feels fully supported.

Our benefits

  • An inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

  • Healthy body, healthy mind: we’ve partnered with Medibank Health Insurance to support your wellbeing.

  • An annual $1,000 self-development budget for anything that fuels your personal growth.

  • 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave, and other parental benefits that support you and your family.

  • Wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave, because time to recharge matters.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

title: Sales Recruiter
description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

About the Role

Apollo is hiring a Sales Recruiter to own full-cycle recruiting across our GTM organization. This is a high-ownership role on a lean, high-performing team. You will manage a portfolio of mid and senior-level requisitions, build and execute sourcing strategies, and serve as a genuine business partner to your hiring managers. This role requires someone who operates with low oversight, self-diagnoses problems before they escalate, and brings a talent advisor posture to every stakeholder conversation. The best person for this role brings their own operating system and makes the team around them sharper.

What You Will Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for mid and senior-level roles across GTM Sales Hiring, with consistent delivery across multiple verticals simultaneously
  • Build and execute sourcing strategies that generate qualified, diverse pipelines, and adapt those strategies based on funnel performance, not just instinct
  • Conduct structured screens and interviews, design interview plans, and lead calibrated debriefs that result in clear, defensible hiring decisions
  • Manage 20+ phone screens per week and drive 360+ outbound contacts per quarter
  • Hold the bar on candidate quality, give direct and honest feedback, and avoid passing weak profiles to sidestep an uncomfortable conversation
  • Maintain accurate, real-time pipeline data in Greenhouse and self-report on progress to leadership without being asked
  • Track funnel metrics, identify root causes of slowdowns, and bring data-informed recommendations to stakeholder conversations
  • Partner with hiring managers and business leaders as a talent advisor: shape role scoping, set expectations on candidate profiles, and influence as a subject matter expert.
  • Work cross-functionally with Finance, HR, and Compensation to navigate offer approvals and headcount processes with operational integrity
  • Build or improve multiple workflows, processes, or tools that create efficiency beyond your own req load

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a focus on Sales or Revenue roles in SaaS
  • Demonstrated delivery in high-growth environments where you managed complexity and ambiguity
  • Comfort and credibility working with stakeholders at all levels, including the ability to challenge and influence, not just execute
  • Strong data fluency: you monitor your own funnel health, diagnose issues before they surface in a check-in, and use data to drive stakeholder conversations
  • Proven AI and process efficiency capability: you have built repeatable workflows or automation that measurably improved your output, and you can speak to what you built, why it works, and what changed
  • Familiarity with Revenue teams, high-performing marketing orgs, and product-led growth models
  • Hands-on experience with Greenhouse and Gem, with clean data hygiene as a non-negotiable operating habit
  • Clear, direct communicator who can influence without authority across functions
  • High agency: you identify problems, generate solutions, and drive progress without waiting for direction

This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

Cloverleaf Care has an immediate opening for a Customer Service Operations Coordinator with 3+ years experience as a Customer Service Representative for our Operations group. This is a remote position ***located in Kenya - any part of Kenya***.

We are a ***direct employer*** and not a recruitment agency.

You will be working the US day shift(7:30PM - 4:30AM EAT, M-F). This is a work from home position.

HOW TO APPLY

Please respond with a complete resume and cover letter using the 'Apply to Position' button on this page.

Candidates must have a laptop or a desktop with a webcam, headset and high speed internet connection to appear for a video interview.

Do NOT apply more than once for this position because it may result in your application being rejected.

COMPENSATION

Compensation will be based on experience, communication quality, assessment results, and fit for long-term healthcare operations work.

OUR PROCESS

title: Behavioral Health Care Coordinator
description:
Citadel Healthcare Management (PVT) LTD. provides healthcare management services for practices across North America. Our dedicated team supports a wide range of medical administration tasks, working collaboratively across multiple disciplines.
Our mission is to offer employees meaningful opportunities to apply their expertise, grow in their careers, and contribute to the organization’s ongoing success.
We are committed to creating a workplace where employees feel valued, supported, and motivated. By fostering a collaborative and engaging environment, we ensure that every contribution is recognized and appreciated.
At Citadel, diversity and inclusion are at the heart of our culture. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds—regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, religion, lifestyle, or disability—and embrace the unique perspectives and experiences they bring. Through teamwork, innovation, and continuous professional development, we empower our employees to thrive and drive progress within the organization.

About the Role

We are seeking a compassionate and highly organized Behavioral Health Case Manager to support patients receiving advanced interventional psychiatric treatments for conditions such as Treatment-Resistant Depression (TRD), PTSD, and OCD. This role serves as a critical liaison between patients, families, providers, and insurance carriers to ensure seamless care coordination, treatment access, and long-term recovery support.

The ideal candidate is passionate about mental health, patient advocacy, and delivering exceptional care throughout the treatment journey.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Intake, Screening & Care Coordination

  • Conduct initial psychosocial and clinical intake assessments to evaluate patient eligibility and readiness for advanced interventional treatments.
  • Educate patients and families regarding treatment processes, timelines, safety protocols, potential side effects, and expected outcomes.
  • Coordinate appointments and treatment schedules with psychiatrists, nurse practitioners, nursing staff, and other multidisciplinary team members.
  • Maintain accurate patient records and ensure timely documentation within the electronic health record (EHR) system.

Care Pathway Management & Patient Support

  • Develop, monitor, and adjust individualized care plans for patients undergoing interventional psychiatric treatment.
  • Conduct regular patient follow-ups to assess treatment progress, identify barriers to care, and promote adherence.
  • Utilize standardized clinical assessment tools, including PHQ-9, GAD-7, and other outcome measures.
  • Provide crisis intervention, safety planning, and appropriate escalation for patients experiencing acute psychiatric distress.
  • Collaborate with clinical providers to address emerging patient needs and treatment concerns.

Utilization Review & Insurance Advocacy

  • Prepare and submit clinical documentation required for prior authorizations and insurance approvals.
  • Coordinate utilization review activities and communicate directly with insurance carriers regarding coverage determinations.
  • Manage appeals for denied services by gathering supporting clinical information and advocating for patient access to care.
  • Assist patients in identifying financial assistance programs, manufacturer support programs, and community-based resources.

Transition & Discharge Planning

  • Develop comprehensive discharge and aftercare plans following completion of intensive treatment programs.
  • Coordinate continuity of care with community psychiatrists, therapists, primary care providers, and support services.
  • Facilitate access to ongoing mental health resources aimed at reducing relapse risk and promoting sustained recovery.

Qualifications

Education

  • MBBS, Psychology, Counseling, Human Services, or a related field required.

Experience

  • Minimum of 1 year of behavioral health case management, care coordination, or patient navigation experience.
  • Experience in an Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP), psychiatric hospital, behavioral health practice, pain management, or neuromodulation/interventional psychiatry setting preferred.
  • Exposure to utilization review, prior authorizations, and insurance appeals is highly desirable.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong understanding of treatment-resistant mental health conditions, including depression, PTSD, OCD, and anxiety disorders.
  • Familiarity with evidence-based assessment tools such as PHQ-9, GAD-7, and similar screening instruments.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA regulations and healthcare compliance standards.
  • Excellent communication, motivational interviewing, and patient engagement skills.
  • Ability to handle sensitive situations with professionalism, empathy, and discretion.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple patient cases simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with EHR systems and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced psychiatric treatment programs.
  • Knowledge of payer authorization requirements and behavioral health reimbursement processes.

title: Real Time Management Analyst
description:
Description

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position reports to the Senior Supervisor of Call Center Operations. The Real Time Analyst is responsible for the successful intra-day monitoring of all Call Center Representatives. This includes the effective management, of the Call Center Representative’s schedules, queues, systems and offline operation support; with a focus on maintaining service levels across all lines of businesses and creating reports as needed.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Call Center Operations

  • Monitor real-time contact center activity, including call volumes, staffing, and service levels, to identify areas for improvement and make timely adjustments.
  • Manage staffing levels dynamically to maintain optimal service levels and meet performance targets.
  • Monitor key metrics such as service levels, average speed of answer (ASA), schedule adherence, average handle time (AHT), and after-call work (ACW), ensuring compliance with defined thresholds.
  • Perform real-time queue management, including agent assignments and skill adjustments, based on established protocols.
  • Coordinate and manage short-term or same-day off-line events for call center agents, ensuring minimal impact on call center performance.
  • Monitor the Attendance Line and update schedules accordingly.
  • Communicate proactively with agents and supervisors via instant messaging to ensure adherence to schedules, resolve real-time issues, and provide timely feedback.
  • Escalate operational issues when necessary to minimize service disruption.
  • Maintain a detailed daily log of actions taken to optimize service levels (e.g., re-skilling agents, reallocating calls, adjusting schedules, initiating or cancelling events).
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other departments to ensure seamless coordination of workforce management activities.
  • Continuously assess and enhance real-time workforce management processes for improved efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Complete reporting or ad hoc analytics as needed.
  • Provides first-level technical support and creates IT support tickets for timely resolution.

Process Improvement

  • Partners with WFM Analyst to manage and implement response plan to ensure schedule adherence, respond to unplanned call outs, and handle staffing time variances.
  • Provide workforce management and scheduling analysis and recommendations for improvement, including headcount requirements, long-term planning, and scheduling, bidding, and staffing strategies.
  • Partners with WFM Analyst forecasting and scheduling team to plan for and understand upcoming anticipated events. Also actively participates in post-event analysis and improvement planning.

Other

  • Utilize all capabilities to satisfy one mission — to enhance the competitiveness and profitability of our members. Do everything possible to help members succeed by being curious and striving to understand what others are trying to achieve, planning and executing work in a helpful and collaborative manner, being willing to adjust efforts to ensure that work and attitude are helpful to others, being self-accountable, creating positive impact, and being diligent in delivering results.
  • Meet all department service, attendance, and performance metrics.
  • All other duties as assigned.
  • Maintain internet speed of 40 MB download and router with wired ethernet.
  • Maintain a HIPAA-compliant workstation and utilize appropriate security techniques to ensure HIPAA required protection of all confidential/protected data.
  • Maintain and service safety equipment (e.g. smoke detector, fire extinguisher, first aid kit)

PHYSICAL DEMANDS/WORKENVIRONMENT

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with others. The employee frequently is required to move around the office. The employee is often required to use tools, objects, and controls. This noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School diploma or equivalent and three (3) to five (5) years of workforce management (WFM) experience in an inbound call center with a solid understanding of Automatic Call Distributor (ACD) call flow technology preferred.
  • Ability to learn and adapt to current WFM tools.
  • Solid mathematical aptitude.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solvingskills.
  • Experience analyzing, interpreting and summarizing complex data as it relates to call center technologies and processes.
  • Ability to establish priorities, multi-task, work in a fast-pacedenvironment and meet tight deadlines, work independently with minimal supervision in a team environment.
  • Advanced computer skills with a variety of software applications including Access, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Visio and Outlook.
  • Proficient at conducting analysis and recommending solutions to improve the performance and efficiency within the Call Centers.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of key call center performance metrics.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.

title: Enterprise Advisory Board
description:
This is a remote position.

Meta Description:Register your interest in advising SME CEOs through Rutherford International’s Enterprise Advisory Board programme. Share your leadership and specialist expertise.

Enterprise Advisory Board — Remunerated Adviser
Evergreen Expression of Interest — Rutherford Talent Guild™
Canada · United States · United Kingdom

Owner-managed and founder-led businesses regularly face decisions that stretch the experience available within their teams: entering a new market, securing financing, planning succession or transforming operations.

Rutherford International welcomes expressions of interest from experienced professionals who can provide relevant expertise, practical perspective and candid, independent challenge to an SME owner or CEO.

This is an Evergreen Expression of Interest, not an advertisement for a current vacancy or advisory appointment.

Who should register
  • Executives, former business owners and senior specialists with demonstrated expertise in growth, financing, operations, technology, people, succession or transformation.
  • Professionals who can adapt their experience to the resources and operating realities of an owner-managed business.
  • Experienced advisers interested in serving individually or within a small advisory group.
  • Professionals with the experience to chair an advisory group and encourage productive discussion.

Professionals based in Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom may register.

The adviser’s contribution

Depending on the mandate, advisers may help an owner or CEO examine strategic and operational decisions by:

  • Understanding the business, its objectives and constraints before offering recommendations.
  • Testing assumptions and identifying practical alternatives.
  • Explaining the evidence, trade-offs and limitations behind their advice.
  • Challenging candidly and respectfully while leaving decisions with the authorised decision-maker.
  • Preparing thoroughly for meetings and following through on agreed contributions.
  • Maintaining confidentiality and declaring potential conflicts of interest.
  • Working constructively with other advisers while allowing differing views to be heard.

Advisory appointments provide non-binding recommendations. They do not, by themselves, confer the authority of a statutory director or responsibility for managing the business.

Relevant experience and qualities

There is no single career route into this role. We look for specific examples of sound judgement, useful advice and contribution to consequential business decisions.

A senior title alone is insufficient. Relevant experience must translate into practical advice suited to the enterprise’s circumstances.

Qualities we value include clear thinking and communication, independent judgement, candour delivered with tact, reliable preparation, openness to contrary evidence and an understanding of the limits of one’s expertise.

Applicants interested in chairing an advisory group should also demonstrate the ability to set focused agendas, balance participation and manage disagreement.

Remuneration

The enterprise pays appointed advisers for their agreed contribution.Remuneration is established for each mandate according to expertise, preparation, time commitment and responsibilities. Arrangements may include retainers, meeting fees or time-based fees.

Advisers do not pay to occupy an advisory seat. This differs from the separate CEO Peer Advisory / Mastermind programme, where members pay to participate.

Registration and consideration

Select“I’m interested”to submit your résumé and professional information through Rutherford International’s Talent Registration form.

Following initial review, a curator may invite you to provide further information and undertake the RutherfordINTEL Assessment. Assessment findings are considered alongside your experience, achievements, objectives and suitability for particular mandates.

Registration is not admission. Progression and membership remain subject to curator review.

Registering does not guarantee membership, representation, an introduction or an advisory appointment.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

description:

Location: Fully Remote (US)

About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.

How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

title: Product Engineer, Shop
description:
ABOUT INSIFY

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. 

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.


About the role

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.


What you'll be doing
  • Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business
  • Continuously and relentlessly seeking opportunities to turn new product demands into platform capabilities and features that scale across countries and insurance product lines
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • 3+ years building complex web applications and services, with real production ownership
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your direct stack to get to results, be that data / backend / frontend
  • You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt
  • Strong fundamentals in domain-driven design & service oriented architecture
    • Not all of the above are hard requirements. If you're strong on most of these and eager to grow into the rest, we'd still love to hear from you.

    Nice to have
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Strong observability instincts. You know where things will break, and can help others learn that too

    • Our stack

    TypeScript across the board, running on AWS (IaaC), in a single monorepo. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason about systems than about which tools you have used before.


    We offer
  • Competitive compensation that reflects responsibility and impact. For this role the range is €65,000 to €85,000.
  • Trust and autonomy. You'll have real ownership, room to make decisions, and space to shape your role as Insify evolves.
  • Hybrid working. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year working from abroad, and 25 holiday days.
  • Pension. We contribute 6% for you.
  • Alleo budget. €50 net a month to spend on whatever you want, from the gym to takeaway. It rolls over if you don't use it.
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs, and coaching to go with them.
  • A central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, whiteboards, and Friday drinks.
  • Hardware & setup. A high-spec MacBook Pro, high-res monitors at the office, and comfortable ergonomic seating.

title: Nyx Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

We want you as a talented Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer to help us in our mission by making sure that Nyx's flight software does exactly what the system needs it to do, and that this is proven at the right level of test.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as a Software Functional System V&V Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Keep a holistic view of the system-level software functional requirements and ensure they are correctly implemented and verified.

  • Decide, per requirement, the right verification level: low-level unit test, SIL scenario, PIL run, HIL run, or vehicle-in-the-loop run.

  • Define, plan, and execute verification campaigns across these levels, and analyse and report the results.

  • Work day to day with the functional chain responsible in each subsystem team to define functional chains, test cases, and required test facilities.

  • Dive into the details when needed: analyse failures in the code and make hands-on adjustments to test scripts, test harnesses, and software, in coordination with the FSW team.

  • Maintain traceability from system requirements to implementation and verification evidence.

  • Review test descriptions, expected inputs and outputs, and verification reports for completeness and correctness.

  • Triage test failures, drive issue resolution with the FSW team, and manage related deviations and waivers.

  • Prepare test readiness and review material, and report verification status to the FSW lead and the Chief Engineer.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Software Functional System V&V Engineer, ideally you will have the following:


What we would love to see from you

  • Degree in Aerospace, Software, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5-10 years of experience working on complex space projects, including software verification and validation of embedded, real-time, or safety-critical systems.

  • Hands-on experience with at least two of: SIL, PIL, HIL, or vehicle-level test campaigns.

  • Holistic system thinker who is also ready to go into the code and make adjustments when the details require it.

  • Strong C/C++ reading and debugging skills, plus scripting for test automation (e.g., Python).

  • Solid understanding of spacecraft subsystems and how functional chains span them (e.g., AOCS, power, thermal, propulsion, avionics).

  • Experience with requirements management and traceability tools.

  • Structured, precise, and ownership-driven, with the ability to align multiple subsystem teams.

  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience in flight software on spacecraft or launch vehicles.

  • Familiarity with NASA & ECSS standards for space software and verification.

  • Experience operating or setting up SIL, PIL, HIL and/or vehicle-in-the-loop facilities.

 

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

The role will deliver marketing support across field marketing to implement marketing campaigns, support event and webinar delivery, monitor social media platforms, and conduct analysis and reporting on the activity.

In addition to being a skilled communicator, the candidate should have excellent multitasking and organisational abilities. title: Superviseur support client international (Support technique opération de tracking sportif) - (H/F)
description:
McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;

  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;

  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;

  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;

  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;

  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;

  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;

  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;

  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;

  • Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels

  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Organisation du travail et horaires

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

  • Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ;

  • À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ;

  • Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation.

Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 3 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit.

L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ;

  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ;

  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;

  • Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ;

  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ;

  • Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ;

  • Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail.

Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise.

La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à temps plein annualisé ;

  • Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ;

  • Poste exercé à 100 % en télétravail, exclusivement depuis un lieu de travail déclaré situé sur le territoire français. Le télétravail depuis l’étranger n’est pas autorisé

  • Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ;

  • Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ;

  • Formation technique assurée en interne ;

  • Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd.

Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd

Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. Vous contribuerez également à la définition des procédures et à l’organisation d’une équipe amenée à se développer progressivement

title: Eid. anerkannte:r Psychotherapeut:in (a) - Hybrid / Region St. Gallen / Wil (40-100%)
description:
Standort: Hybrid (Home Office mit Remote Video Therapie sowie Möglichkeit von Arbeit vor Ort)

Anstellung: Festanstellung mit vielen Freiheiten dank Gleitzeitmodell; zudem auch flexibles Lohnmodell möglich mit Gewinnbeteiligung, bei selbstbestimmter Abrechnung und eigener Gestaltung des Caseload

Pensum: 40-100%

Start: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Warum Oviva?

In der Schweiz beschäftigen wir rund 150 Mitarbeitende, darunter Psychotherapeut:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen und Ärztinnen und Ärzte. Gemeinsam bieten wir eine integrierte Behandlung für Menschen mit Adipositas und anderen metabolischen Erkrankungen an, die Ernährung, Bewegung, Psychotherapie und, wo medizinisch sinnvoll, medikamentöse Therapie verbindet. Unsere eidgenössisch anerkannten Psychotherapeut:innen arbeiten eng mit dem Behandlungsteam zusammen, damit emotionale Belastung und Essverhalten gemeinsam angegangen werden. Bei Oviva prägen flache Hierarchien, Gestaltungsspielraum und grosse Flexibilität bei der Arbeitszeit unsere Zusammenarbeit.

Die Stelle

Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang. Unsere Patientinnen sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patientinnen mit gewichts- und ernährungsbedingten Grundproblemen benötigen Unterstützung bei diversen psychischen und neurodivergenten Herausforderungen, wie etwa ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depressionen oder Angststörungen. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen eine ganzheitliche, respektvolle und wirksame therapeutische Begleitung zu bieten – jenseits von Stigmatisierung und oberflächlichen Ansätzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Psychotherapien in unserer Praxis und online via Video-Sessions durch.

  • Du arbeitest eng und interdisziplinär in einem multiprofessionellen Team (u.a. mit Ärztinnen) zusammen, um eine umfassende Betreuung zu gewährleisten.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie moderne, digitale Psychotherapie bei Oviva aussieht.

  • Du bringst Deine Expertise als Psychotherapeut:in ein, um Versorgung neu zu denken und echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

Dein Profil

  • Eidg. anerkannte Psychotherapeut/in

  • Abgeschlossenes klinisches Jahr in einer Institution der SIWF Kategorie A, B oder C

  • Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit

  • Deine fundierte psychotherapeutische Kernkompetenz ist genau das, was wir suchen – ein zusätzliches, spezifisches Vorwissen im Bereich Ernährung oder Gewicht wird nicht vorausgesetzt.

Was Dich bei Oviva erwartet

  • Wirkung mit Sinn: Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das die moderne Gesundheitsversorgung revolutioniert und ganzheitliche Therapieansätze fördert.

  • Dynamische Kultur: Ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Kreativität und Veränderung gefördert werden.

  • Regelmässige Inter- und Supervision, intern und extern: Du wirst unmittelbar durch eine*n erfahrene*n Fachpsychologin/Fachpsychologen in die Arbeit eingeführt und in regelmässigen 1:1 Gesprächen sowie Intervisionen in deiner Arbeit begleitet. Zudem erhältst du die Möglichkeit, an regelmässigen Supervisionen mit externen Expert*Innen in unserem Berufsfeld teilzunehmen und dich dort aktiv einzubringen.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Familienfreundliche Anstellungsbedingungen, hohe Life-Work-Balance: Durch unser Gleitzeitmodell und unsere Home Office Möglichkeiten kannst du dir deine therapeutische Arbeitszeit einteilen, wie es für dich am besten in dein Leben passt.

Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung. Weitere Informationen findest Du auf unserer Homepage: https://oviva.com/ch/de/psychotherapie/.

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen: Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich.

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür, eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiterinnen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Wir begrüssen und ermutigen Bewerberinnen mit allen Hintergründen und Identitäten einschliesslich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Nationalität, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, Fähigkeiten, Religion und sozioökonomischen Status. Wir suchen aktiv nach Kandidatinnen, die eine einzigartige Perspektive mitbringen, um uns beim Aufbau eines stärkeren, inklusiven Teams zu helfen.

Oviva engagiert sich für die Unterstützung von Kandidatinnen und Mitarbeiter*innen mit Behinderungen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb Dich noch heute!

title: Care Navigator
description:
The Care Navigator is responsible for conducting social care screenings, eligibility assessments, referral coordination, and ongoing care navigation activities for Medicaid members and other eligible populations participating in Social Care Network (SCN), 1115 Waiver, ILOS, Value-Added Benefit (VAB), and related programs. This work is completed telephonically.

The Care Navigator provides person-centered, culturally responsive, trauma-informed telephonic and technology-enabled navigation services designed to identify unmet health-related social needs and connect individuals to appropriate community-based resources and services. Responsibilities include screening completion, eligibility verification, referral placement, closed-loop referral follow-up, documentation, consent management, and coordination with community-based organizations, managed care organizations, and healthcare partners.

Documentation and tracking activities will occur within both internal and external technology platforms. The Care Navigator is expected to maintain compliance with organizational policies, state program requirements, productivity standards, quality metrics, and confidentiality regulations.

The Care Navigator reports to the Care Navigation Program Manager. This is a remote position that may be located anywhere in the United States but CST or EST hours will be worked. Occasional travel to offices in Iowa and New York may be required.

Hourly wage: $23/hour

Position Responsibilities may include, but not limited to

  • Conduct standardized, health-related social needs screenings in accordance with state and program requirements
  • Complete eligibility assessments and supporting documentation for social care services and enhanced navigation programs
  • Initiate, monitor, and close referrals within designated referral management platforms
  • Accurately document and record service activities, encounters, and time spent in accordance with program billing and reporting requirements
  • Perform closed-loop referral follow-up activities to confirm service connection and identify unresolved barriers
  • Conduct outreach attempts and follow-up activities in accordance with program timelines and documentation standards
  • Educate clients regarding available community resources, benefits, and social care services
  • Coordinate with healthcare providers, managed care organizations, and community-based organizations to support continuity of care
  • Escalate complex cases, urgent social needs, or safety concerns to supervisory or clinical staff as appropriate
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA, confidentiality requirements, and all applicable state and federal regulations
  • Meet productivity, timeliness, documentation, and quality assurance standards established by the organization and program requirements
  • Participate in ongoing training, workflow updates, and quality improvement initiatives
  • Support reassessment and renewal activities as required by program guidelines

Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum of two (2) years’ experience in a healthcare, social service, or behavioral health setting; this may include any role with direct client contact
  • Ability to engage individuals experiencing complex social and health-related barriers with empathy and professionalism
  • Ability to maintain accurate and detailed documentation in compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements
  • Prior work that included in-person or telephonic interactions with clients or patients
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other standard office technology platforms
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to prioritize competing tasks and projects effectively
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while exercising sound professional judgment
  • Ability to routinely use standard office equipment and technology, including laptop computers and smartphones

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Training or certification in Trauma-Informed Care, Motivational Interviewing, and/or Crisis De-escalation techniques
  • Experience working with individuals experiencing food insecurity, substance use disorders, behavioral health needs, homelessness, and/or transition from incarceration or institutional settings
  • Previous experience providing telephonic screenings, care navigation, care management, vocational rehab, or health coaching services

Physical Requirements

  • Repetitive motions that include the wrists, hands and/or fingers
  • Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting, remaining in a stationary position for prolonged periods
  • Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

Our team members enjoy:

  • Eligible for Referral Bonuses starting Day 1
  • Weekly paychecks
  • PTO, 401k, & a Full benefits package

Compensation

Additional Information

Company Overview

Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.

EEO

Mom’s Meals complies with all applicable federal and state non-discrimination laws. Qualified applicants shall receive consideration for employment without regards to race, religion, national origin, ancestry, color, gender, age, disability, or veteran status.

At Navan, our mission is to power the in-person connections that move people, ideas and businesses forward. We help our travelers focus on being there, not getting there and our Global Operations and Service team is central to this mission!

As a member of our quickly growing Global Operations and Service team, you will be responsible for directly supporting our users’ travel needs. As owners of customer satisfaction, your role is to solve issues, communicate effectively, and collaborate with internal teams to remove any barriers for the traveler - all while providing a best-in-class customer experience. As the front line of our business, you will have a unique opportunity to provide regular feedback to our product, design and engineering teams as they work towards continually improving our customer facing and internal platforms. This is an exciting role where you will have a direct impact on our day to day operations, traveler experience and product development!

What You’ll Do:

  • Assist our travelers with best-in-class travel support through multiple contact channels: chat, calls and email.
  • Maintain extensive supplier, destination and system knowledge.
  • Make quick and accurate analyses of customer needs, persona and level of urgency.
  • Provide accurate information for hotel, flight, car and rail bookings, as required
  • Support users with self-service of the Navan platform and app where possible.
  • Respond to customers within SLA expectations and requirements.
  • Follow company and customer travel and expense procedures and policies in addition to global compliance procedures.
  • Provide regular feedback to stakeholders on the progress of goals and performance of key operating processes.
  • Participate in team meetings to stay up to date with new product launches, supplier updates, and industry changes.
  • Build upon your travel industry knowledge to continue to set the standard for best-in-class travel support.
  • Adhere to attendance policy and complete all assigned training.
  • Meet individual performance metrics in support of the organization and company business objectives.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5+ years managing bookings for corporate and leisure clients in a core Business Travel environment
  • 3+ years of demonstrated advanced Sabre or Amadeus GDS experience (ticketing, reissues, voids, cancellations, EMD and MCO issuance/reissuance, PNR management, etc.) is mandatory
  • Experience of local market supplier content and booking practices in both ARC and BSP markets

  • Experience with NDC, low-cost carriers and third party content aggregators and their booking management practices is a plus

  • Skilled communicator, proficient in both verbal and written English language. Additional language skills (fluent speaker) outside of English is a bonus, but not a requirement

For roles with on-target-earnings (OTE), the pay range includes both base salary and target incentive compensation. Target incentive compensation for some roles may include a ramping draw period.
